entities.name: UniProt Q9DCQ3
observations: The supplied 133-aa sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Mus musculus vesicle transport protein GOT1A (UniProt Q9DCQ3).
Reference annotation: Golgi membrane multipass protein; may participate in fusion of ER-derived transport vesicles with Golgi.
Pfam Got1 domain PF04178 spans residues 14–109 in the query sequence.

entities.name: GO:0006888 ER-Golgi transport
observations: Reference annotation associates GOT1A with endoplasmic-reticulum-to-Golgi vesicle-mediated transport.

entities.name: GO:0042147 Endosome-Golgi transport
observations: Reference annotation associates GOT1A with retrograde transport from endosomes to Golgi.
